packet_component_identity.conclusion: A canonical Critical-plus-Lucky row is the dedicated packet Lucky damage component carrying the critical type flag. It is not a normal-plus-Lucky combined damage total.

symbols.C: current packet critical chance raw value
symbols.dc: packet-proven provider critical chance raw delta
symbols.L: current packet Lucky chance raw value
symbols.dl: packet-proven provider Lucky chance raw delta
symbols.cd: current packet critical damage raw value

decomposition: The provider owns the complete Lucky component on the dl/L share of Lucky occurrences caused by that provider.
On the remaining (L-dl)/L Lucky occurrences, the provider owns only the critical bonus fraction caused by dc/C.
The two terms are combined before reduction, so their intersection is assigned exactly once and the observed Lucky component is conserved.
exact_joint_counterfactual.numeric_runtime: checked i128 exact rational; no per-event floating point and no per-hit truncation

retained_scope.policy: Rows without an exact packet-proven external Inspiration instance magnitude remain visible and contribute no guessed transfer.
